source_findings.topic: Independent namespace, arguments and bounded work
source_findings.finding: The local launcher invokes the new controller, not the existing M7 controller. Its fixed argv matches the new parser and uses its own full_official_frozen_public_identity_m8_preflight_20261005 root and own session proof. The controller serially executes exactly axis_shared, frequency_shared and twins_shared, each once with the native verifier and once with --mode smoke. Every child receives MSVR310, freeze=1, seed42 and the same anchor/data/pretrained paths. No --mode train, missing49 evaluation, diagnosis or raw-archive path is launched.

source_findings.topic: Actual final M7 GPU3 release and permitted overlap
source_findings.finding: Both local-launch readiness and the new controller require the original twins_shared_fixed diagnosis exit_code=0 on gpu3, its recorded PID absent from /proc, and real GPU3 memory below 500 MiB. The controller additionally checks the original anchor path and that twins_shared/freeze1 is last in the real GPU3 schedule. Inspection of the original jobs loop shows only JSON checks, frozen archive/receipt work and CPU closeout after that final diagnosis; there is no later GPU3 neural job. execute enforces CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3, serial waits and a 240-second capacity polling interval. The new path leaves GPU2 to M7, so the known original two-lane schedule plus serial M8 lane respects at most two neural jobs. No all-five/global archive barrier is introduced, and no GPU0/1, temperature or power control is added. These are source conclusions; actual process/capacity conditions were not observed by this reviewer.

source_findings.finding: M8 uses the existing M7 anchor builder and exact public_outlet_identity_training.step callback. Source computes 0.5*0.1=0.05 public CE on each of the full and partial actual fused descriptor slices5120:5632 with the existing shared_neck/shared_classifier. Both existing full/partial original losses remain present. Controller checks positive public terms, total weight0.1, two added shared-neck calls, zero new parameters/backbone passes, frozen flag, one added loss, stopped reference and actual optimizer update for the native detail and every smoke detail. The reused step asserts finite total full and partial losses before backward; no new or modified loss/head/backbone code is introduced.

source_findings.topic: Preserved native equality, frozen encoder, gradients, Adam and strict reload
source_findings.finding: The verifier replaces parent VARIANTS/build/step globals used by the actual parent main. The parent retains exact reference-00 equality for all seven availability sets, frozen encoder train/eval-surroundings equality, six-module requires_grad/eval/state-buffer checks, a single real optimizer update with zero skip, finite nonzero gradients for every optimizer tensor, the same-gradient Adam replay with rtol1e-6/atol1e-7 and strict reload with exact descriptor equality. Controller accepts only that native status plus the required counts and frozen/reload flags. These runtime assertions have been traced in source and have not been empirically passed by this review.

source_findings.topic: Smoke rejects AMP skips and compares actual M7 capacity
source_findings.finding: Although the reused smoke loop can make extra attempts until three successful updates, the M8 controller requires steps==attempts==3 and amp_skipped_steps==0, plus strict reload and all finite/nonzero active gradient checks. Native counts must be 1032/591/1055 with zero heldout identities. Native total/trainable parameters and active names are compared to the corresponding actual original M7 contract JSON. Each smoke is compared to its native contract, then all three variants are pairwise equal in parameter counts and active names. The source uses complete official records and the original anchor manifest check; it does not create a holdout.

source_findings.topic: Existing stdout framing, EOF and zero-archive receiver
source_findings.finding: Controller saves its own preflight_result.json before emit(PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE). Reused emit uses the exact OFFICIAL_STREAM prefix expected by archive_session. Child output is redirected into independent contract/smoke logs; ordinary controller lines are intentionally forwarded without being parsed as events. mode=preflight accepts exactly one PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE, rejects raw/frozen/run events, then requires EOF and ssh/controller exit0 with no archives/runs before writing the new local proof. It does not invoke the imported bridge main or attach to the existing M7 session.

Native and smoke strict reload serialize to BytesIO; smoke returns before formal training/evaluation. The new path writes metadata and logs in its own directory, asserts no .pth output, and records three native updates, nine smoke updates, zero frozen cases, zero new weights, formal50_started=0 and goal_complete=false only after all gates pass. The generic stream proof with mode=preflight means completion of this zero-archive protocol; it does not prove M7 global archive completion or M8 retrieval quality. No dataset images, model weights or raw retrieval outputs are copied by this preflight.
